lines.text: اما کسوف چون نیرین در احد العقدتین یا حوالی مجتمع شوند بنوعی که چون خطی از بصر خارج شود
lines.en: As for a solar eclipse, when the two luminaries conjoin at one of the two nodes or in their vicinity, in such a way that when a line extends from the sight

lines.text: و بجرم شمس واصل گردد و بجرم قمر نیز گذشته باشد در اینحال لا محاله قمر میانه ابصار و شمس
lines.en: and reaches the body of the sun, and has also passed through the body of the moon, in this case the moon is inevitably between the sights and the sun,

lines.text: حایل گردد و بواسطه کثافت قطع نور شمس از ابصار کند بعضا او کلا و چون قطعه ظلمانی
lines.en: acting as a barrier, and by means of its density it cuts off the light of the sun from the sights, partially or totally. And since the dark segment

lines.text: ماه در اینحال بجانب ارض بود برنگ اصلی خود نماید پس چنان مظنون گردد که افتاب
lines.en: of the moon in this case is towards the earth, it appears in its original color, so it is suspected that the sun

lines.text: سیاه شده است و اینحالترا کسوف گویند که در لغت بمعنی قطع نور باشد و منکشف بحسب
lines.en: has become black. This state is called a solar eclipse (kusūf), which in the language means the cutting off of light. And the eclipsed portion, according to

lines.text: اختلاف بقاع مختلف شود و شاید که در بعضی بلاد مرئی شود دون بعضی بخلاف مقدار
lines.en: the difference of regions, differs, and it may be visible in some cities and not in others, unlike the magnitude

lines.text: منخسف که در جمیع بقاع یکسان نماید چه اینحالت نفس ماه را عارض شود و صورت کسوف
lines.en: of the eclipsed portion (in a lunar eclipse), which appears the same in all regions, because this state occurs to the moon itself. And the form of a solar eclipse

lines.text: عادت قوم باینجاری شده است که در اخر تقویم موارد خسوف و کسوف بیاورند از
lines.en: The custom of the people has become such that at the end of the almanac they bring the occurrences of lunar and solar eclipses, from

lines.text: جهت انکه ایراد آن در اول تقویم تفالا او تیمنا نیک نباشد چه در اغلب احوال این دو
lines.en: the reason that bringing it at the beginning of the almanac is not good as an omen or blessing, because in most cases these two

lines.text: حادثه را اثرات مذمومه نویسند و ساعات گذشته از اول روز یا اول شب در ابتداء
lines.en: events are written to have blameworthy effects. And the hours passed from the beginning of the day or the beginning of the night at the start

lines.text: وسط و ابتداء مکث و ابتداء تمام انجلا و همچنین ساعات گذشته از ابتداء خسوف
lines.en: of the middle, and the start of the duration, and the start of the complete clearance, and also the hours passed from the start of the lunar eclipse

summary.headline: Solar Eclipses and Almanac Omens
summary.text: Explanation of solar eclipses (kusūf): conjunction of the Sun and Moon near the lunar nodes, the Moon’s obstruction of sunlight, and why eclipse visibility varies by region. The text also discusses the customary placement of lunar- and solar-eclipse predictions at the end of almanacs and records eclipse-duration timings.
